# Togakushi ⇆ Nagano


Togakushi – Nagano Sightseeing Bus (Starts from April 1, 2025)


- Starting from December 6, 2025, this winter bus will make a stop at the Okusha Tokusha Bus Stop, the entrance to the ancient cedar tree path. From the bus stop, it takes about a 20-minute walk to the red Zuishinmon Gate.
- To ensure passenger safety and comfort, **all seats require a reservation**. You don’t have to worry about not getting a seat due to full capacity.
- You can store your suitcases and large luggage in the trunk room.
- You can ride without a reservation if there are empty seats, but booking in advance lets you board smoothly without waiting in line. You can pay the fare on the bus using **contactless-enabled** **VISA cards or cash**.
- Some bus stops arefor boarding only or drop-off only. Please check the timetable carefully.
- IC cards like SUICA cannot be used on this bus.
- Please note that the Togakushi & Zenkoji 1-Day Pass will be discontinued as of April 1, 2025.
- On the bus from Togakushi to Nagano, you may board at a different stop on the same reserved bus as long as the fare does not change. However, even if there are seats available, you cannot use your reserved ticket for a different bus. Please cancel your reservation before the cancellation deadline and make a new booking. (The cancellation deadline is printed on your ticket.)

- Bus number 73 is no longer in service.
- Bus number 70 is a dedicated, non-reserved service primarily intended for local residents of Togakushi. For tourists, please use the reserved Nagano–Togakushi bus, which is shown on this page.

### Important Info

![reservation-error-icon](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/hs-fs/hubfs/images/icon/reservation-error-icon.png?width=500&height=500&name=reservation-error-icon.png)Troubles while making a reservation online

- Alpico does not handle the operation of the reservation website. If you encounter issues like your card being denied, the reservation page loading slowly, not sure what to fill in the form, error occuring while proceeding, or being unable to proceed despite availability, etc., please reach out to Keio Dentetsu, which is the company that manages the reservation website, directly at [info@highwaybus.com](mailto:info@highwaybus.com) for help.
- We often receive inquiries about card denials, but when we test it, it usually works fine. So, please try using other cards or attempt booking later the next day or contact your card issuer.
- When making a reservation online, if your country phone number has less than 9 digits, add a 0 at the beginning to meet the requirement (9-11 digits).
- If you don’t see the bus you want to book on the booking website,it means that bus is full. Please choose another available bus.
- The online reservation system and the ticket counter share the same seat availability.If online bookings show no available seats, the ticket counter will have the same status.
- To check seat availability for the reserved bus, please visit the reservation page. If the bus is fully booked, you will see indicators such as “×”, “No Seat Available”, or “Not Available”. We will not answer to the inquiries about the seat availability.
- When making a reservation, please check this box (reCAPTCHA) to proceed with your booking.

![i-am-not-robot](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/hs-fs/hubfs/i-am-not-robot.png?width=439&height=184&name=i-am-not-robot.png)

![ticketing-icon](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/hs-fs/hubfs/images/icon/ticketing-icon.png?width=500&height=500&name=ticketing-icon.png)Ticket Reservation / Cancellation / Change

##### **Ticket Reservation**

- Please make a reservation by yourself. We do not accept reservation requests, regardless of the number of passengers or requests from travel agencies.
- The online reservation system and the ticket counter share the same seat availability.If online bookings show no available seats, the ticket counter will have the same status.
- If you encounter any issues while making a reservation, please contact [info@highwaybus.com](mailto:info@highwaybus.com) or use the [Contact Form](https://japantripsearch.com/). Alpico does not manage the reservation system.

##### **Ticket Cancellation**

- Please access " [My Reservation](https://www.highwaybus.com/gp/inbound/inbRsvSearch)" page and proceed with the reservation cancellation.
- If you cannot log into "My Reservation" page, please contact [info@highwaybus.com](mailto:info@highwaybus.com) or use the [Contact Form](https://japantripsearch.com/). Alpico does not manage the reservation system.
- Cancellation fee applies 100 yen per person.

##### **Ticket Change**

- You cannot change your reservation information (time/date/name etc.). Please cancel and make a new reservation by yourself online from [this page](https://japanbusonline.com/en/BookInquiry).
- If you cannot log into "My Reservation" page, please contact [info@highwaybus.com](mailto:info@highwaybus.com) or use the [Contact Form](https://japantripsearch.com/). Alpico does not manage the reservation system.
- Cancellation fee applies 100 yen per person.

- **Boarding Location**

Please board the bus from bus stop no. 7 near Nagano station Zenkoji exit.  The bus stop is in front of the Alpico Bus Ticket Office. ( [Google Map](https://www.google.com/maps/place/%E3%82%A2%E3%83%AB%E3%83%94%E3%82%B3%E4%BA%A4%E9%80%9A+%E9%95%B7%E9%87%8E%E9%A7%85%E5%89%8D%E6%A1%88%E5%86%85%E6%89%80/data=!4m2!3m1!1s0x0:0x299d8f3be9e631ca?sa=X&ved=1t:2428&ictx=111))

- **How to Board the Bus**

After purchasing tickets online, you can confirm and make changes to the ticket type from the " [My Reservation](https://www.highwaybus.com/gp/inbound/inbRsvSearch)" page. There are two types of online tickets.

**1\. Mobile Ticket (Recommended):**

Show the ticket on your smartphone screen when boarding.

- After completing your reservation and payment, click the **"Send Mobile Ticket"** button.
- A link to your mobile ticket will be sent to your registered email.
- If needed, you can log into the **"My Reservation"** page and click **"Send Mobile Ticket"** again to resend the ticket.

**2\. Web Ticket:**

Print out the ticket and show it to the bus staff or driver when boarding.

- After purchasing a ticket online, click the **"Display/Print Web Ticket"** button.
- This will open the ticket for you to print.
- If needed, you can log into the **"My Reservation"** page and click " **Display/Print Web Ticket"** button again to resend the ticket.

[Detailed Instructions with Illustrations on How to Receive Your Ticket >](https://highway-buses.jp/boarding)

[See how to board the bus (video) >](https://highway-buses.jp/movie/boarding/en.mp4)

##### Children’s fares

- **Age 0:** Free of charge
- **Age 1-6:** For legal and safety reasons, it is **recommended** that children in this age group have a reserved child fare seat. Please check the booking site for the exact fare.
- **Age 7-12:** Child fare(Please confirm the exact child fare on the reservation website.)
- **Age 13+:** Adult Fare

※By law, children and infants who do not occupy a seat (e.g., sitting on a parent’s lap) are also counted as passengers. If a child does not have a reserved seat when the bus is fully booked, this will be considered over capacity and boarding may be denied. Therefore, we recommend reserving a seat for your child and infant, even if they do not intend to use it.

※ Alpico does not operate its own reservation websites. Similar to hotel booking sites, bus tickets are sold through third-party reservation platforms such as [japanbusonline.com](https://japanbusonline.com/) or [highwaybus.com](https://www.highwaybus.com/gp/inbound/index). If there is any discrepancy between the child fare categories shown on the reservation site and those stated on this page, the information on this page takes priority.

# Togakushi ⇆ Nagano


Togakushi – Nagano Sightseeing Bus (Starts from April 1, 2025)


- To ensure passenger safety and comfort, **all seats require a reservation**. You don’t have to worry about not getting a seat due to full capacity.
- You can store your suitcases and large luggage in the trunk room.
- You can ride without a reservation if there are empty seats, but booking in advance lets you board smoothly without waiting in line. You can pay the fare on the bus using **contactless-enabled** **VISA cards or cash**.
- Some bus stops arefor boarding only or drop-off only. Please check the timetable carefully.
- IC cards like SUICA cannot be used on this bus.
- Please note that the Togakushi & Zenkoji 1-Day Pass will be discontinued as of April 1, 2025.
- On the bus from Togakushi to Nagano, you may board at a different stop on the same reserved bus as long as the fare does not change. However, even if there are seats available, you cannot use your reserved ticket for a different bus. Please cancel your reservation before the cancellation deadline and make a new booking. (The cancellation deadline is printed on your ticket.)
- For travel within the Togakushi area, please use the [Togakushi Shuttle Bus](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/timetable/togakushi-shuttlebus?hsLang=en).
- Bus number 73 is no longer in service.
- Bus number 70 is a dedicated, non-reserved service primarily intended for local residents of Togakushi. For tourists, please use the reserved Nagano–Togakushi bus, which is shown on this page.

- We often receive inquiries about card denials, but when we test it, it usually works fine. So, please try using other cards or attempt booking later the next day or contact your card issuer.
- When making a reservation online, if your country phone number has less than 9 digits, add a 0 at the beginning to meet the requirement (9-11 digits).
- If you don’t see the bus you want to book on the booking website,it means that bus is full. Please choose another available bus.
- The online reservation system and the ticket counter share the same seat availability.If online bookings show no available seats, the ticket counter will have the same status.
- To check seat availability for the reserved bus, please visit the reservation page. If the bus is fully booked, you will see indicators such as “×”, “No Seat Available”, or “Not Available”. We will not answer to the inquiries about the seat availability.
- When making a reservation, please check this box (reCAPTCHA) to proceed with your booking.

##### **Ticket Reservation**

- Please make a reservation by yourself. We do not accept reservation requests, regardless of the number of passengers or requests from travel agencies.
- The online reservation system and the ticket counter share the same seat availability.If online bookings show no available seats, the ticket counter will have the same status.
- If you encounter any issues while making a reservation, please contact [info@highwaybus.com](mailto:info@highwaybus.com) or use the [Contact Form](https://japantripsearch.com/). Alpico does not manage the reservation system.

##### **Ticket Cancellation**

- Please access " [My Reservation](https://www.highwaybus.com/gp/inbound/inbRsvSearch)" page and proceed with the reservation cancellation.
- If you cannot log into "My Reservation" page, please contact [info@highwaybus.com](mailto:info@highwaybus.com) or use the [Contact Form](https://japantripsearch.com/). Alpico does not manage the reservation system.
- Cancellation fee applies 100 yen per person.

##### **Ticket Change**

- You cannot change your reservation information (time/date/name etc.). Please cancel and make a new reservation by yourself online from [this page](https://japanbusonline.com/en/BookInquiry).
- If you cannot log into "My Reservation" page, please contact [info@highwaybus.com](mailto:info@highwaybus.com) or use the [Contact Form](https://japantripsearch.com/). Alpico does not manage the reservation system.
- Cancellation fee applies 100 yen per person.

![bus-location-icon](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/hs-fs/hubfs/images/icon/bus-location-icon.png?width=500&height=500&name=bus-location-icon.png)How to Board the Bus

- **Boarding Location**

Please board the bus from bus stop no. 7 near Nagano station Zenkoji exit.  The bus stop is in front of the Alpico Bus Ticket Office. ( [Google Map](https://www.google.com/maps/place/%E3%82%A2%E3%83%AB%E3%83%94%E3%82%B3%E4%BA%A4%E9%80%9A+%E9%95%B7%E9%87%8E%E9%A7%85%E5%89%8D%E6%A1%88%E5%86%85%E6%89%80/data=!4m2!3m1!1s0x0:0x299d8f3be9e631ca?sa=X&ved=1t:2428&ictx=111))

- **How to Board the Bus**

After purchasing tickets online, you can confirm and make changes to the ticket type from the " [My Reservation](https://www.highwaybus.com/gp/inbound/inbRsvSearch)" page. There are two types of online tickets.

**1\. Mobile Ticket (Recommended):**

Show the ticket on your smartphone screen when boarding.

- After completing your reservation and payment, click the **"Send Mobile Ticket"** button.
- A link to your mobile ticket will be sent to your registered email.
- If needed, you can log into the **"My Reservation"** page and click **"Send Mobile Ticket"** again to resend the ticket.

**2\. Web Ticket:**

Print out the ticket and show it to the bus staff or driver when boarding.

- After purchasing a ticket online, click the **"Display/Print Web Ticket"** button.
- This will open the ticket for you to print.
- If needed, you can log into the **"My Reservation"** page and click " **Display/Print Web Ticket"** button again to resend the ticket.

[Detailed Instructions with Illustrations on How to Receive Your Ticket >](https://highway-buses.jp/boarding)

[See how to board the bus (video) >](https://highway-buses.jp/movie/boarding/en.mp4)

If you cannot log into your reservation page, please contact Highwaybus.com directly:

- If the new schedule is not yet available, we kindly ask for your patience. Please refrain from inquiring about the release date, as we cannot offer additional details beyond what is provided on the timetable page.
- This bus service operates year-round, with only minor changes to the schedule compared to last year. Until the updated timetable is released, you may refer to last year's schedule as a guide.

- This bus has a luggage compartment where you can stow your suitcases. There are no restrictions on the number or size of items.
- However, we do not take any responsibility for any damage to your belongings.

![toilet-icon](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/hs-fs/hubfs/images/icon/toilet-icon.png?width=500&height=500&name=toilet-icon.png)Onboard Facilities

- This bus does not have a restroom onboard, and there are no restroom breaks during the journey.
- This bus is not equipped with a wheelchair lift or designated wheelchair space, so it cannot accommodate passengers who wish to remain in their wheelchair during the journey. Please fold your wheelchair and store it in the bus's luggage compartment. Kindly note that unfolded wheelchairs cannot be accepted.

- Only one-way tickets are available; there is no round-trip fare.

| Nagano Station ～ Iizuna Kogen / Nagano Forest Village | Adult | 1,500 yen |

##### Children’s fares

- **Age 0:** Free of charge
- **Age 1-6:** For legal and safety reasons, it is **recommended** that children in this age group have a reserved child fare seat. Please check the booking site for the exact fare.
- **Age 7-12:** Child fare(Please confirm the exact child fare on the reservation website.)

※By law, children and infants who do not occupy a seat (e.g., sitting on a parent’s lap) are also counted as passengers. If a child does not have a reserved seat when the bus is fully booked, this will be considered over capacity and boarding may be denied. Therefore, we recommend reserving a seat for your child and infant, even if they do not intend to use it.

※ Alpico does not operate its own reservation websites. Similar to hotel booking sites, bus tickets are sold through third-party reservation platforms such as [japanbusonline.com](https://japanbusonline.com/) or [highwaybus.com](https://www.highwaybus.com/gp/inbound/index). ### Important Info (for green season)

[Click here for the timetable and details for winter season >](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/timetable/hakuba-nagano-winter-reserved?hsLang=en)

![ticketing-icon](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/hs-fs/hubfs/images/icon/ticketing-icon.png?width=500&height=500&name=ticketing-icon.png)Ticketing

- You cannot reserve a seat or buy a ticket in advance, even one day prior. Boarding is on a first-come, first-served basis, and purchasing a ticket does not guarantee that you will be able to board your preferred service.
- Please purchase your ticket on the day of boarding, and then join the boarding queue.

- The bus ticket for the Nagano to Hakuba line that you purchased allows you to board any bus on the same day.

- If you are concerned that the bus might be full, please line up early.
- We add more buses during busy times. But if the bus becomes full, please board the next available bus.

![luggage-icon](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/hs-fs/hubfs/images/icon/luggage-icon.png?width=500&height=500&name=luggage-icon.png)Luggage

- This bus has a luggage compartment where you can stow your suitcases. There are no restrictions on the number or size of items.

![timetable-icon](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/hs-fs/hubfs/images/icon/timetable-icon.png?width=500&height=500&name=timetable-icon.png)Timetable Updates

- The timetable for the green season will be updated around mid-March.
- We apologize for any inconvenience. We cannot provide the exact release date for the timetable. The schedule will be posted on the timetable page once it has been confirmed.
- If the schedule for next year is not yet available, we kindly ask for your patience. Please refrain from inquiring about the release date, as we cannot offer additional details beyond what is provided on the timetable page.
- This bus service operates year-round, with only minor changes to the schedule compared to last year. Until the updated timetable is released, you may refer to last year's schedule as a guide.

![toilet-icon](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/hs-fs/hubfs/images/icon/toilet-icon.png?width=500&height=500&name=toilet-icon.png)Onboard Facilities

- This bus does not have a restroom onboard, and there are no restroom breaks during the journey.
- This bus is not equipped with a wheelchair lift or designated wheelchair space, so it cannot accommodate passengers who wish to remain in their wheelchair during the journey. Please fold your wheelchair and store it in the bus's luggage compartment. Kindly note that unfolded wheelchairs cannot be accepted.

[![Green Season Banner (en)](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/hs-fs/hubfs/images/%E6%99%82%E5%88%BB%E8%A1%A8%E9%96%A2%E9%80%A3%E3%83%90%E3%83%8A%E3%83%BC/Green%20Season%20Banner%20(en).png?width=476&height=119&name=Green%20Season%20Banner%20(en).png)](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/timetable/hakuba-nagano-green?hsLang=en)


Please take a moment to read this guide.


This winter, we are operating both non-reserved and reserved bus services.

**Non-Reserved Buses**

- Most non-reserved buses operate directly between Happo Bus Terminal and Nagano Station without stopping at other bus stops.
- Multiple buses depart at the same time from both Happo Bus Terminal and Nagano Station.
- Same-day ticket only.

**Reservation-only Buses**

- Only one bus is available for each scheduled trip, and there will be no additional buses.

### Important Info

![ticketing-icon](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/hs-fs/hubfs/images/icon/ticketing-icon.png?width=500&height=500&name=ticketing-icon.png)Ticket Purchase

- **This is a non-reserved bus; it is not possible to purchase or reserve tickets in advance.**
- Please purchase your bus ticket on the day of travel and then join the boarding queue. Boarding is on a first-come, first-served basis, and purchasing a ticket does not guarantee that you will be able to board your preferred service.
- If you board the bus at a stop without a ticket counter, you can buy your ticket from the bus driver when boarding, using cash or Visa contactless card. (IC cards such as SUICA are not accepted.)

![timetable-icon](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/hs-fs/hubfs/images/icon/timetable-icon.png?width=500&height=500&name=timetable-icon.png)Timetable Updates

- **We typically update this timetable in late March.**
- If the schedule for next year is not yet available, please be patient for its release. **We kindly ask that you refrain from inquiring about the release of the new timetable,** as we cannot provide more details than what is available on the timetable page.
- The timetable is not expected to change significantly from last year, so please refer to the timetable from the previous year until the updated one becomes available.

![concern-bus-full-icon](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/hs-fs/hubfs/images/icon/concern-bus-full-icon.png?width=500&height=500&name=concern-bus-full-icon.png)Group Reservation

- We do not accept reservation requests, regardless of the number of passengers or requests from travel agencies.

![luggage-icon](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/hs-fs/hubfs/images/icon/luggage-icon.png?width=500&height=500&name=luggage-icon.png)Luggage Allowance

This bus has a luggage compartment where you can stow your suitcases. There are no restrictions on the number or size of items.


![bus-pass-icon](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/hs-fs/hubfs/images/icon/bus-pass-icon.png?width=500&height=500&name=bus-pass-icon.png)About Tateyama Route Option Ticket

- You cannot board the bus by just showing the QR code.
- Seat reservations are also not available. If the bus is full, please wait for the next available bus.
- [Please check the instructions on how to receive your ticket and board the bus from this link.](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/info/web_ticket.html?newwindow=true&wid=-3060467767230323003&_gl=1*1svj8dy*_ga*MzA1MjcyNTEyLjE3NDM0NzYwNDI.*_ga_8MQPY5SC52*MTc0MzQ3NjA0Mi4xLjEuMTc0MzQ3NjA2OC4wLjAuMA..) (Click on the " **STEP3: Receive Tickets**" Tab.)

If you have further inquiries, please inquire the [operating company](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/) directly. Thank you.

![bus-pass-icon](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/hs-fs/hubfs/images/icon/bus-pass-icon.png?width=500&height=500&name=bus-pass-icon.png)About Alpine-Takayama-Matsumoto Area Tourist Pass

You **cannot** use the Alpine-Takayama-Matsumoto Area Tourist Passto board Nagano - Omachi/Ogizawa bus.


![reservation-error-icon](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/hs-fs/hubfs/images/icon/reservation-error-icon.png?width=500&height=500&name=reservation-error-icon.png)Boarding the bus between Shinano-Omachi Station and Holiday Inn Resore Kuroyon

You cannot board the bus between Shinano-Omachi Station and Holiday Inn Resort Kuroyon. Please use the [Shinano Omachi – Ogisawa Line](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/timetable/omachi-ogizawa?hsLang=en) for this section.

\*\*Only one-way tickets are available; there is no round-trip fare.

##### About Child Fares

- **Age 0:** Free of charge. However, if a child occupies a seat, a child fare ticket is required. Please note that by law, children are counted as passengers even when they do not occupy a seat (e.g., when sitting on a parent’s lap). If all seats are taken and a child does not have their own seat and ticket, this will be considered over capacity, and boarding may be denied.
- **Age 1-** **12:** Child fare (half of adult price)

### Important Information

![reservation-error-icon](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/hs-fs/hubfs/images/icon/reservation-error-icon.png?width=500&height=500&name=reservation-error-icon.png)Troubles while making a reservation online

- Alpico does not handle the operation of the reservation website. If you encounter issues like your card being denied, the reservation page loading slowly, not sure what to fill in the form, error occuring while proceeding, or being unable to proceed despite availability, etc., please reach out to Keio Dentetsu, which is the company that manages the reservation website, directly at [info@highwaybus.com](mailto:info@highwaybus.com) for help.
- We often receive inquiries about card denials, but when we test it, it usually works fine. So, please try using other cards or attempt booking later the next day or contact your card issuer.
- When making a reservation online, if your country phone number has less than 9 digits, add a 0 at the beginning to meet the requirement (9-11 digits).
- If you don’t see the bus you want to book on the booking website, it means that bus is full. Please choose another available bus.
- The online reservation system and the ticket counter share the same seat availability. If online bookings show no available seats, the ticket counter will have the same status.
- To check seat availability for the reserved bus, please visit the reservation page. If the bus is fully booked, you will see indicators such as “×”, “No Seat Available”, or “Not Available”. We will not answer to the inquiries about the seat availability.
- To ensure that individuals of different genders do not sit next to each other, we have certain seating restrictions. This means that even if there are available seats, you may not be able to book due to the seating configuration enforced by the reservation system. Please note that this restriction does not apply to reservations made for the same group. The gender specified on the ticket will be strictly enforced, and passengers with a different gender on their tickets will be declined boarding. We are sorry, but we cannot help you with this issue due to the system configuration.
- When making a reservation, please check this box (reCAPTCHA) to proceed with your booking.

![i-am-not-robot](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/hs-fs/hubfs/i-am-not-robot.png?width=439&height=184&name=i-am-not-robot.png)

- When making a reservation, to reverse the route direction, please click the button below.



![route_diverse](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/hs-fs/hubfs/route_diverse.png?width=990&height=173&name=route_diverse.png)


![ticketing-icon](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/hs-fs/hubfs/images/icon/ticketing-icon.png?width=500&height=500&name=ticketing-icon.png)Ticket Reservation / Purchase

##### **Ticket Reservation**

- Please make a reservation by yourself. We do not accept reservation requests, regardless of the number of passengers or requests from travel agencies.
- The online reservation system and the ticket counter share the same seat availability.If online bookings show no available seats, the ticket counter will have the same status.
- If you encounter any issues while making a reservation, please contact [info@highwaybus.com](mailto:info@highwaybus.com) or use the [Contact Form](https://japantripsearch.com/). Alpico does not manage the reservation system.

##### **Ticket Cancellation**

- Please access " [My Reservation](https://www.highwaybus.com/gp/inbound/inbRsvSearch)" page and proceed with the reservation cancellation.
- If you cannot log into "My Reservation" page, please contact [info@highwaybus.com](mailto:info@highwaybus.com) or use the [Contact Form](https://japantripsearch.com/). Alpico does not manage the reservation system.
- Cancellation fee applies 100 yen per person.

##### **Ticket Change**

- You cannot change your reservation information (time/date/name etc.). Please cancel and make a new reservation by yourself online from [this page](https://japanbusonline.com/en/BookInquiry).
- If you cannot log into "My Reservation" page, please contact [info@highwaybus.com](mailto:info@highwaybus.com) or use the [Contact Form](https://japantripsearch.com/). Alpico does not manage the reservation system.
- Cancellation fee applies 100 yen per person.

![bus-icon](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/hs-fs/hubfs/bus-icon.png?width=500&height=500&name=bus-icon.png)About Bus Operation

- Please check the timetable carefully to confirm the operation dates. We do not respond to inquiries regarding this matter.
- If there is no Nagano-Kamikochi bus service on your travel date, please travel to Matsumoto first by train and take the [Matsumoto-Kamikochi bus](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/timetable/kamikochi-matsumoto?hsLang=en) instead.
- Kamikochi is closed every year from November 16 to April 16. During this period, there is no bus service to Kamikochi.

![bus-location-icon](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/hs-fs/hubfs/images/icon/bus-location-icon.png?width=500&height=500&name=bus-location-icon.png)How to Board the Bus

- **Boarding Location**

Please board the bus from bus stop no. 25 near Nagano station east exit.

- **How to Board the Bus**

After purchasing tickets online, you can confirm and make changes to the ticket type from the " [My Reservation](https://www.highwaybus.com/gp/inbound/inbRsvSearch)" page. There are two types of online tickets.

**1\. Mobile Ticket (Recommended):**

Show the ticket on your smartphone screen when boarding.

- After completing your reservation and payment, click the **"Send Mobile Ticket"** button.
- A link to your mobile ticket will be sent to your registered email.
- If needed, you can log into the **"My Reservation"** page and click **"Send Mobile Ticket"** again to resend the ticket.

**2\. Web Ticket:**

Print out the ticket and show it to the bus staff or driver when boarding.

- After purchasing a ticket online, click the **"Display/Print Web Ticket"** button.
- This will open the ticket for you to print.
- If needed, you can log into the **"My Reservation"** page and click " **Display/Print Web Ticket"** button again to resend the ticket.

There is no bus service to Kamikochi from November 16 until April 16, and we do not provide tours to Kamikochi.

**About the bus to Kamikochi**

- The nearest bus stop to Kamikochi in winter is the K-26 Nakanoyu bus stop. To reach Nakanoyu bus stop, you can board the [Matsumoto - Takayama bus](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/timetable/takayama-matsumoto-winter?hsLang=en). An advance reservation is required. Please check the fares from the [timetable page](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/timetable/takayama-matsumoto-winter?hsLang=en).
- From Nakanoyu bus stop, you will need to walk or use snowshoes, approximately 1 hour (3 km) to Taisho Pond and about 2 hours (7 km) to Kappa Bridge. The time required may be significantly longer depending on the snow conditions and weather.


**For those who plan to enter Kamikochi during this period**

- Please be aware that winter mountain climbing/snowshoeing is undertaken at your own risk. Kamikochi experiences rapidly changing winter weather conditions, with potential dangers such as avalanches, falling rocks, and ground blizzards.
- When entering, you must complete a climbing registration at the entrance (Nakanoyu Gate) and submit it in the designated box. We highly recommend you join a tour with a professional guide when going to Kamikochi in winter. One of our recommended guides is [Raicho Guesthouse](https://ghraicho.com/).
- [See map and toilet locations here](https://www.kamikochi.or.jp/news/4641/#:~:text=%E4%B8%AD%E9%83%A8%E5%B1%B1%E5%B2%B3%E5%9B%BD%E7%AB%8B%E5%85%AC%E5%9C%92%E4%B8%8A,%E4%BA%8B%E9%A0%85%E3%82%92%E5%BF%85%E3%81%9A%E3%81%8A%E5%AE%88%E3%82%8A%E3%81%8F%E3%81%A0%E3%81%95%E3%81%84%E3%80%82). For more details, please inquire [Kamikochi's official website](https://www.kamikochi.org/).
- [Download Climbing Registration Form >](https://www.pref.nagano.lg.jp/kankoki/smartphone/documents/keikakusho.pdf)

\*\*Only one-way tickets are available; there is no round-trip fare.

##### Children’s fares

- **Age 0:** Free of charge
- **Age 1-6:** For legal and safety reasons, it is **recommended** that children in this age group have a reserved child fare seat. Please check the booking site for the exact fare.
- **Age 7-12:** Child fare(Please confirm the exact child fare on the reservation website.)
- **Age 13+:** Adult Fare

※By law, children and infants who do not occupy a seat (e.g., sitting on a parent’s lap) are also counted as passengers. If a child does not have a reserved seat when the bus is fully booked, this will be considered over capacity and boarding may be denied. Therefore, we recommend reserving a seat for your child and infant, even if they do not intend to use it.

※ Alpico does not operate its own reservation websites. Similar to hotel booking sites, bus tickets are sold through third-party reservation platforms such as [japanbusonline.com](https://japanbusonline.com/) or [highwaybus.com](https://www.highwaybus.com/gp/inbound/index). If there is any discrepancy between the child fare categories shown on the reservation site and those stated on this page, the information on this page takes priority.

### Important Info

![ticketing-icon](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/hs-fs/hubfs/images/icon/ticketing-icon.png?width=500&height=500&name=ticketing-icon.png)Ticket Reservation / Purchase

- This bus can be reserved 1 month prior to the travel date.
- Please purchase your ticket online.
- We do not accept reservation via phone or email.
- If seats are available on the day of travel, you may purchase a ticket from the ticket counter.

![reservation-error-icon](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/hs-fs/hubfs/images/icon/reservation-error-icon.png?width=500&height=500&name=reservation-error-icon.png)Troubles while making a reservation online

- Alpico does not handle the operation of the reservation website. If you encounter issues like your card being denied, the reservation page loading slowly, not sure what to fill in the form, error occuring while proceeding, or being unable to proceed despite availability, etc., please reach out to Keio Dentetsu, which is the company that manages the reservation website, directly at [info@highwaybus.com](mailto:info@highwaybus.com) for help.
- We often receive inquiries about card denials, but when we test it, it usually works fine. So, please try using other cards or attempt booking later the next day or contact your card issuer.
- When making a reservation online, if your country phone number has less than 9 digits, add a 0 at the beginning to meet the requirement (9-11 digits).
- If you don’t see the bus you want to book on the booking website,it means that bus is full. Please choose another available bus.
- The online reservation system and the ticket counter share the same seat availability.If online bookings show no available seats, the ticket counter will have the same status.
- To check seat availability for the reserved bus, please visit the reservation page. If the bus is fully booked, you will see indicators such as “×”, “No Seat Available”, or “Not Available”. We will not answer to the inquiries about the seat availability.
- When making a reservation, please check this box (reCAPTCHA) to proceed with your booking.

![i-am-not-robot](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/hs-fs/hubfs/i-am-not-robot.png?width=439&height=184&name=i-am-not-robot.png)
- When making a reservation, to reverse the route direction, please click the button below.



![route_diverse](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/hs-fs/hubfs/route_diverse.png?width=990&height=173&name=route_diverse.png)


![luggage-icon](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/hs-fs/hubfs/images/icon/luggage-icon.png?width=500&height=500&name=luggage-icon.png)Luggage

This bus service is **jointly operated by Alpico and Keio Bus**. Please check the timetable on this page to see which company operates the bus you plan to take.

#### **For Alpico Bus**

**For daytime bus**

- There are no specific size or number restrictions for suitcases, but we strongly recommend bringing up to two items in total. Possible combinations include:
  - 1 suitcase + 1 pair of skis
  - 2 suitcases
- The bus trunk has limited storage space, and we may not be able to accommodate all luggage. If you have more than two pieces of luggage, we recommend using a delivery service to send your extra items to your hotel in advance.

**For overnight bus**

- Skis, snowboards, and bicycles are not allowed, even in the trunk.
- For suitcases, there are no specific size or number restrictions, but we strongly recommend bringing only one suitcase. If the bus trunk becomes full, we may not be able to store additional luggage.
- If you have two or more pieces of luggage, we recommend using a delivery service to send them to your hotel in advance.

#### **For Keio Bus**

- Each passenger can check one suitcase or one pair of skis (or one snowboard).
- A second piece of luggage may be accepted only if there is space available in the trunk on the day
- No size restrictions for checked suitcases.
- Skis and snowboards must be placed in a cover bag.

![concern-bus-full-icon](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/hs-fs/hubfs/images/icon/concern-bus-full-icon.png?width=500&height=500&name=concern-bus-full-icon.png)Check Seat Availability

- To check seat availability, please visit the reservation page. If the bus is fully booked, you will see indicators such as “×”, “No Seat Available”, or “Not Available”.
- The online reservation system and the ticket counter share the same seat availability. If online bookings show no available seats, the ticket counter will have the same status.
- Please check seat availability on the website yourself. We will not answer to the inquiries about the seat availability.
- Please refrain from inquiring whether the bus will be full on specific dates, as we are unable to provide a definite answer.

![timetable-icon](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/hs-fs/hubfs/images/icon/timetable-icon.png?width=500&height=500&name=timetable-icon.png)Timetable Update

**Timetable Update for 2026-2027 winter season**

- We apologize for any inconvenience. We cannot provide the release date for the timetable. The schedule will be posted on the timetable page once it has been confirmed. (around mid-November)
- If the winter schedule is not yet available, we kindly ask for your patience. Please refrain from inquiring about the release date, as we cannot offer additional details beyond what is provided on the timetable page.
- This bus service operates year-round, with only minor changes to the schedule compared to last year. Until the updated timetable is released, you may refer to last year's schedule as a guide.

![bus-location-icon](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/hs-fs/hubfs/images/icon/bus-location-icon.png?width=500&height=500&name=bus-location-icon.png)Bus Stop Location

This bus typically has a restroom onboard. However, on some additional buses or due to inspection schedules, there is a possibility that there may not have restroom available. Whether they have restrooms or not, there is usually a restroom break at a service area or parking area.

### Fare

| Shinjuku ～ Hakuba Area | 6,400～7,800 yen |
| Shinjuku ～ Shinano Omachi | 5,800～7,200 yen |

\*\*Only one-way tickets are available; there is no round-trip fare.

\*\*An extra separate fee (2,000 yen per person) is required when getting on the late night bus (Bus Number 5517, dep. from Shinjuku at 23:05).

For child fares, please refer to the [Child Fare Rules](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/alpico-bus-fare#fare-type-1).

Hakuba Happo Bus Terminal

Opening Hours：8:00〜17:00

- For non-reserved buses, please buy your ticket from the vending machine (cash only).

- For reserved buses, please buy your ticket online (credit card) or from the bus driver when you board (cash or contactless Visa credit card).

- Please note that the Hakuba Happo Bus Terminal is NOT operated by Alpico. The ticketing hours may be changed. For the most updated info, please [inquiry at the bus terminal](https://www.happo-one.jp/en/info/) directly.

Alpico Kotsu Hakuba Office

Opening Hours：6:30〜18:00
